notes.title: English language update
notes.notes:
Hello from those of us at Tales~Shop!

We've got a new update for Miracle Snack Shop!

1. We have updated our previous translation with a newer one that will help create a more immersive and enjoyable experience for you!

We've also fixed:

2. A few spelling and grammar errors in various places
3. And fixed a few bugs that we have found.

As always, thank you for your interest in Tales~Shop!
